_provenance: Dirt/SuperDirt wire-format fixtures for the bridge conformance test.
These are the exact bytes SuperDirt would receive: OSC address, typetag string,
then big-endian arguments with 4-byte alignment. They were encoded with the
reference OSC encoder from the argument lists Tidal's Dirt client sends.
They are NOT a capture from a live Tidal session: this host has no GHC and no
Tidal, so a live capture cannot be made here. What the test proves is therefore
wire-format conformance — the bridge decodes these bytes and produces typed
Brahma messages — not interoperability observed against a running Tidal.
When Tidal is available, replacing `play` with a real capture is the upgrade.
The test reads bytes, not JS objects, so that swap changes nothing else.
